Gold.note: Strong central bank demand and anticipated rate cuts support further upside.

Silver.note: Robust photovoltaic demand and monetary tailwinds drive a structural deficit.

Copper.note: Grid upgrade demand offsets property weakness amid tight concentrate supply.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and renewed global nuclear capacity buildouts.

Lithium.note: Persistent oversupply and moderating EV demand growth weigh on pricing.

Nickel.note: Surging Indonesian supply and weak stainless steel demand cap upside.

Zinc.note: Mine supply disruptions and low smelter treatment charges tighten the market.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese property sector offsets marginal infrastructure stimulus.

Coal.note: High global inventories and renewable energy substitution limit thermal coal upside.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply risks offset by near-term weak EV motor demand.

Manganese.note: Balanced steel demand and emerging battery-grade supply constraints.

PGM.note: Substitution by palladium and weak auto production constrain near-term demand.

Potash.note: Steady global agricultural application rates and restricted Eastern European exports.

Aluminum.note: Smelter capacity caps in China and strong lightweighting demand support prices.

Diversified.note: Broad commodity basket provides a reliable hedge against idiosyncratic single-metal risks.
